question: Can I afford a Goa trip next weekend?
headline: Only if you skip clubbing and parties this month. Otherwise Goa eats your safety buffer.

evidence.finding: Sat 10 Oct - Sun 11 Oct fully free
1 email contains instructions aimed at the AI - treated as data, not followed
Avg spend Rs 46,320/mo; fixed commitments Rs 15,617/mo (rent, SIPs, subscriptions, phone)
Stay + food + scooter for 1 night / 2 days: Rs 3,600 - Rs 7,900

tradeoffs: Skip Sunday club nights for a month: frees ~Rs 9,350
Skip Friday parties this month: frees ~Rs 3,995
Halve dinners out with friends: frees ~Rs 1,575
Book the 06:10 IndiGo + a hostel to stay near the low end (Rs 11,709)
Finish the quarterly report by Friday - it is due Monday 10:00.
